definitions.explanation: Digital or virtual assets that use cryptographic technology for secure transactions. The official Japanese term adopted by the Financial Services Agency, replacing the earlier 仮想通貨.

examples.japanese: {暗号資産|あんごうしさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
{暗号資産|あんごうしさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。

⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暗号資産|あんごうしさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, profits from cryptocurrency are subject to taxation.

notes:
USAGE:
The official term used in Japanese law and by the Financial Services Agency ({金融庁|きんゆうちょう}) since 2019, replacing ⟦{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}→仮想通貨：06400_kasoutsuuka⟧ (virtual currency). In everyday conversation, ⟦{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}→仮想通貨：06400_kasoutsuuka⟧ is still commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗号資産|あんごうしさん}⟦{取引所|とりひきじょ}→取引所：17223_torihikijo⟧ (cryptocurrency exchange)
- {暗号資産|あんごうしさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売買|ばいばい}→売買：04336_baibai⟧ (buying and selling crypto)
- {暗号資産|あんごうしさん}{交換業者|こうかんぎょうしゃ} (crypto exchange operator)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}→仮想通貨：06400_kasoutsuuka⟧: virtual currency (older, informal term for the same concept)
